Post 1
🔺 ASX closed at 8,431 points last week as US rate cut bets firmed. The central tension: can materials hold the rally if China stimulus disappoints? Cautiously bullish — but the 8,500 ceiling is the test. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2
⛏️ Materials face a binary week — iron ore near USD 98/t means any Beijing policy signal moves the miners hard. Banks watch Tuesday's RBA decision; no cut priced, but the tone shifts credit sentiment fast. #ASX #ironore #RBA #banking

Post 3
🔻 Watch Pilbara Minerals this week. Spodumene spot has slid toward USD 750/t, pressuring margins at the cost curve. Any guidance revision moves the lithium complex with it. #ASX #lithium #mining

Post 4
S&P 500 closed at 5,611 — holding above its 50-day. Fed's preferred PCE print lands Friday US time. A hot read reprices rate cuts and hits AUD, dragging yield-sensitive ASX sectors at Monday's open. #ASX #ausbiz #Fed #inflation

Post 5
Tuesday's RBA decision is the calendar risk. Market prices on hold at 4.10%. A hawkish hold lifts AUD and squeezes property. A dovish tilt sparks a rate-sensitive rally. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #property

Post 1

New 50-day low set, then buyers stepped in. ASX 200 closed +0.17% at 8,679.70, up 14.70pts. Health Care and Financials carried the index while Materials dragged. Flat YTD but the low is a flag worth watching. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🟢 Health Care +1.49%, Financials +1.16%. 🔴 Materials -1.34%, IT -0.74%. Classic defensives-over-cyclicals rotation — not a growth signal, a caution one. #ASX #ausbiz #mining

Post 3

🪙 NST surged +6.15% to AUD 23.47 as gold hit AUD 5,970.77/oz. When spot metal runs, the miners follow fast. Northern Star was the clearest expression of that trade today. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 4

Gold at AUD 5,970.77/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7019. Silver AUD 87.55/oz. A softer AUD amplifies every gold move for local producers — watch that FX handle closely. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

Materials fell -1.34% despite gold strength. The question this week: can gold break AUD 6,000/oz? If AUD softens further, that level is close. Where do you see gold by Friday? #gold #ASX #ausbiz
